scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.mobile:assemble: pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile exec expo prebuild --platform android --no-install --clean && pnpm --filter @workspace/mobile exec ./android/gradlew assembleRelease -x lint --no-daemon
